g.text: AN/SMC-925 // SHEET 2 OF 2: 360° PINWHEEL SIDES & I/O INSERT (US LETTER 8.5×11") — ALIGN FRAME: 240.00 × 154.00 MM
▲ REAR BULKHEAD (222.43×23.80mm) ▼ FRONT OPERATOR CHEAT SHEET (222.43×23.80mm)
1. Page Setup: Letter 8.5×11" Landscape, Reg Marks ON (Type 1)
2. Open 300 DPI PNG (240×154 mm) → Center to Page → Set PNG No Cut
3. Open DXF → Cmd+A, Cmd+G (Group!) → Paste & Center to Page
4. Ungroup DXF & set outer 240×154 mm frame to No Cut · Print 100%
REAR-02 // FLASH MAP, SYSEX & SAFE-MODE RECOVERY
CBL0: Master MIDI · CBL1: Private Sinco · CBL2: Mackie
Power-cycle 2× in 5s → skips pads/keys, keeps BLE + OTA!
USB_KEY handshake on DP/DM enters BR25 Mask-ROM loader
P1-8 Rate · P9-13 Swg · P14 Fill
P15 Ext Clock · P16 Tap Tempo
0 LIT = FOLLOW · BANK K3/4 = TRK · ⇧+K3/4 = GLOBAL
Vol / Vel / Prob / Qnt / BPM: P1→16
